Definition 1.2 ([1, Definition 1.2, p. 1]). The cycle space of a quiver \(Q\) is the kernel \(\mathcal {Z}(Q)\) of the divergence map \(\partial \colon \mathbb {Z}^{A(Q)} \to \mathbb {Z}^{V(Q)}\) whose value at a vertex \(v\) is the total weight of the arrows with target \(v\) less the total weight of the arrows with source \(v\).
